fit_circle_2d: fit a circle to 2D points using least squares and return center, radius, and generated points
fit_circle_3d: fit a circle to 3D points by projecting to the best fit plane and solving in 2D
get_rotation_to_best_fit_xy: compute a rotation matrix that aligns the best fit plane of 3D points to the XY plane
create_Circle2D: create a Circle2D dataclass with center, radius, and generated points along the circle
create_Circle3D: create a Circle3D dataclass with center, radius, normal vector, and generated points in 3D space
